_comment: Third-party sources NOT covered by Dependabot (vendored copies + doc-pinned tools). Every source must declare a boolean auto_update: false keeps drift visible but blocks scheduled and direct mutation; true permits the existing reviewed update lane. Drift is checked by scripts/check_thirdparty_drift.py and .github/workflows/thirdparty-drift.yml. Dependabot already handles pip/npm/github-actions — see .github/dependabot.yml.
